page.overview:
Who is Shigeru Kamado?

Shigeru was a young boy with a light complexion. Like the rest of his family, Shigeru had white-pupiled eyes, whose irises were black at the top and dark red at the bottom. His black hair was worn as a buzz cut.

Shigeru wore a light green and black-patterned kimono with a light green haori over it. He also sported a white nagajuban under everything.

Shigeru appearef to be very fond of his brother Tanjiro, wanting to follow him wherever he goes and do whatever he does. Like his siblings, he was upset when Tanjiro and his mother told him he could not go to town with him.

Shigeru grew up on a mountain alongside his siblings and mother. He is the second youngest son of the Kamado family.
